customer_message.subject: chat – shutters, Rebbergstrasse 107
customer_message.body:
Owen Mehta: Hello, I need help with my landlord, the Probst heirs (Erbengemeinschaft Probst). I rent a 4.5-room flat at Rebbergstrasse 107 in Kreuzlingen
Owen Mehta: Both roller shutters in the living room and bedroom are broken and can't be raised, since July
Owen Mehta: the heirs say it's wear and tear of the straps and want to replace straps. A shutter company told me the motors and the guide rails are damaged and that it may be a construction fault. So someone qualified actually has to examine them, otherwise they'll just put new straps on and it breaks again
Owen Mehta: and no, there's no damp or mould problem, the flat is dry
Owen Mehta: also I don't know, the rooms feel colder than usual this autumn, but no idea if the heating is actually faulty or if it's because the shutters let the cold in. haven't checked
Owen Mehta: I sent them a letter with a deadline, attached, plus my lease. I meant every word of the last paragraph
Owen Mehta: what happens after 9 November if nothing is done?
